excerpts: Census data.json (1807 datasets, sha 8af42774) entry #329: title Time Series Small Area Health Insurance Estimates; identifier https://api.census.gov/data/id/SAHIE; temporal 2006/2024; spatial US; accessLevel public; license CC0; API endpoint http://api.census.gov/data/timeseries/healthins/sahie; schema links variables.json / geography.json / tags.json / examples.json / groups.json; description: single-year health-insurance coverage estimates for all counties by selected economic/demographic characteristics; SAHIE models combine ACS survey data + administrative records + Census 2020 data.

api/views i46a-9kgh: name PLACES: County Data (GIS Friendly Format), 2025 release; 168 columns. Description: model-based county-level estimates, GIS-friendly; covers 50 states + DC at county/place/tract/ZCTA; sources BRFSS 2023 or 2022 + Census 2023 county pop + ACS 2019-2023 or 2018-2022; 2025 release uses 2023 BRFSS for 35 measures, 2022 for 5 (teeth lost, dental, mammograms, colorectal screening, short sleep); join with Census 2023 county boundaries for 40 county measures; ArcGIS feature service available. Column pattern per measure: <M>_CrudePrev / _AdjPrev / _Crude95CI / _Adj95CI; keys StateAbbr/StateDesc/CountyName/CountyFIPS + TotalPopulation/TotalPop18plus (Census 2023). license PUBLIC_DOMAIN; contact places@cdc.gov; measure definitions https://www.cdc.gov/places/measure-definitions/index.html (referenced, not fetched: host out of scope).

AHRF Definition PDF (6 pp, Jan 2026): dashboard is a subset of full county-level + national/state-level AHRF files at https://data.hrsa.gov/data/download?data=AHRF#AHRF. County and state files use different sources so county sums do NOT equal state/national counts. Release year = fiscal year of development (Oct 1-Sep 30); per-variable years differ (2024-2025 release: county MD/dentist thru 2023 AMA/ADA; county NP thru 2024 NPI; county pop thru 2024 Census; state thru 2023 ACS PUMS). Dashboard shows calendar year. CT: 9 planning regions replaced 8 counties (OMB 2022); files carry both FIPS schemes; dashboard uses 9 since 2025. County sources: AMA (MD/DO), ADA (dentists), CMS NPI/NPPES (nurses, PAs); pop: Census estimates/characteristics/SAIPE. State sources: ACS 5-Year PUMS, SOC 2018, workforce = age 16+ worked in last 5 years; suppression PRSE>30% shown NA. Clinician rate = count/pop*100000.

api/views e2d5-ggg7: 12 columns: Data As Of / Jurisdiction (occurrence) / Group / Subgroup / Year of Death (12-month ending year) / Month of Death / Time Period / Month Ending Date / Maternal Deaths (ICD-10 A34, O00-O95, O98-O99) / Live Births (12-month-ending) / Maternal Mortality Rate / Footnote (suppressed 1-9). Description: national-level provisional rates per 100000 live births from NVSS current flow; 12-month-ending periods (compare year-to-year, not month-to-month); rates <20 deaths suppressed (NCHS reliability); counts 1-9 suppressed (confidentiality); quarterly updates with revisions of prior releases. Suggested citation DOI 10.15620/cdc/20250305011; technical notes https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nvss/vsrr/provisional-maternal-deaths.htm (referenced, not fetched).

api/views 5eh7-pjx8: 12 columns: Year / Question / Area / Area_abbr / Demographics_Type / Demographics_Value / Percent (1-decimal) / Low_Confidence_Interval / High_Confidence_Interval / Confidence_Interval_Formatted / Data_Label / Percentile_Range. Description: telephone interviews of US adults; system covers 50 states + DC + Guam/PR/VI, but this product reports participating jurisdictions only - nationwide estimates are not available. Geographic Unit of Analysis: State. Contact mentalhealthdata@cdc.gov; see https://www.cdc.gov/mental-health/about-data/mental-health-data-sources.html (referenced, not fetched).

SAHIE variables.json: 39 variables. Dimensions: AGECAT (7: under 65, 18-64, 40-64, 50-64, under 19, 21-64, 21-29), IPRCAT (6: all, <=200%, <=250%, <=138%, <=400%, 138-400% poverty), RACECAT, SEXCAT, YEAR enum 2006..2024, GEOCAT summary level. Identifiers: GEOID (State+County FIPS), STATE, COUNTY, STABREV, NAME, US national flag. Estimates: NIPR_PT (denominator), NIC_PT (insured), NUI_PT (uninsured), PCTIC_PT/PCTUI_PT (percents) each with _MOE/_LB90/_UB90 uncertainty. Predicates: for/in (FIPS), time (datetime year, required).
SAHIE geography.json: fips levels us (010), state (040), county (050, requires state, wildcard state), referenceDate 2020-01-01. County queries require a state predicate.
